title: [v1.6.6] mandatory wrapper-only closure replay (5+5 serial)
message:
This is a protocol-mandated v1.6.6 closure broadcast for all runtime identities.

Required (serial, no parallel):
1) refresh contracts: python3 scripts/repair_contract_backfill.py --catalog <runtime_catalog> --identity-id <identity_id> --apply --json-only
2) ensure wrapper signer env is set for your identity: IDENTITY_PROTOCOL_GATEWAY_SIGNING_SECRET_<IDENTITY_UPPER>=<secret>
3) run strict update chain through creator: python3 scripts/identity_creator.py update --identity-id <identity_id> --mode safe-auto --actor-id <actor_id> --session-id <session_id> --why-now v166_closure --planned-file <plan_file>
4) run 5 serial self-tests via wrappers (ingress->unique-entry->egress), each round must PASS_REQUIRED
5) run 5 serial deep scans: python3 scripts/full_identity_protocol_scan.py --scan-mode target --identity-ids <identity_id> --target-source-layer <project|global> --actor-id <actor_id> --session-id <session_id> --expected-work-layer instance --expected-source-layer <project|global> --out <out_json>
6) ack this broadcast after completion: python3 scripts/identity_broadcast_ack.py --catalog <runtime_catalog> --identity-id <identity_id> --ack-all-pending --actor-id <actor_id> --session-id <session_id> --json-only

Pass criteria: self-test(5/5 PASS_REQUIRED) + deep-scan(5/5 rc=0,p0=0,m2m_fail=0). If failed, emit protocol-feedback outbox with error codes and rerun after repair.

notes: Use protocol tools; no manual runtime hand wiring.
